title: Exercise Settings capability toggles through M8 workspace Skill execution
goal: Verify that the M8 Chat-to-Skill runtime denies workspace writes while the Settings write toggle is off and permits exact verified writes after the toggle is enabled.
context: Issue #347 requires capability toggles to be enforced by the runtime path, not only by isolated policy unit tests. This regression uses an isolated UserDefaults suite and the actual M8 workspace.create-file Skill/Module path.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify production authorization behavior as part of this test-only task.
Do not weaken workspace path validation, protected-file checks, secret detection, size limits, read-back verification, cancellation, or approval gates.
Do not use an unconditional AllowPolicy for this scenario; exercise SettingsBackedPolicyEvaluator.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance from CI results.
acceptance_criteria: With read and execute enabled but write disabled, a real M8 workspace create-file request is denied and no file is created.
After enabling write on the same SettingsBackedPolicyEvaluator, the next supported request writes the exact expected content and returns verified success.
The test uses isolated UserDefaults and cleans up its temporary workspace.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA checks pass.
verification: Inspect Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow results.
Physical iPhone acceptance remains tracked separately under Issue #347.
recovery: If the policy denial is surfaced through a wrapper error, assert the concrete denial without loosening the policy. If execution cannot proceed after enabling write, diagnose the missing required capability at the Skill or Module boundary.
